title: Golden Ticket Pickleball hits Las Vegas! - NewsBreak
text:
By Jenelle Vannoy No media credit provided. ,
4 hours ago
LAS VEGAS (KLAS) — USA Pickleball is bringing the excitement back to Las Vegas!
Get ready—the USA Pickleball Golden Ticket – Las Vegas, presented by Tommy Bahama, is rolling into town next month!
Las Vegas to break ground on 24-court pickleball hub After a smash-hit 2024 tournament, this premier qualifying event is back and bigger than ever. These tournaments aren’t just any competition—they’re your gateway to the USA Pickleball National Championships, the ultimate showdown in the sport.
‘Atomic Echoes’ documentary screening announced at Las Vegas theater Winners will snag the coveted Golden Ticket, guaranteeing priority registration for Nationals. And don’t worry—every player earns points toward USA Pickleball’s Tiered Point System, so everyone gets in on the action.
The USA Golden Ticket Pickleball Tournament will be held at the Plaza Hotel and Casino next month (Credit: USA Golden Ticket Pickleball) Golden Ticket Tournaments are where the best of the best come to play!
These events attract top players from across the country and deliver a first-class experience—featuring certified referees, official rules, and venues designed for fair and competitive play. Additionally, as sanctioned USA Pickleball events, every participant earns official DUPR ratings and ranking points, enabling athletes to track their progress and climb the competitive ladder.
Download the 8 News Now Vegas streaming app “We’re thrilled to bring the Golden Ticket back to Las Vegas at the iconic Plaza Hotel & Casino, with more than 500 athletes expected,” said Jose Moreno, Chief Marketing Officer of USA Pickleball. “This venue lets us create an unforgettable experience—from professional operations to the electric energy that makes Las Vegas such a special host city. Golden Ticket tournaments are a key part of The Path to Nationals, and Las Vegas is the perfect stage for players to test themselves and compete among the best in the country.”
The USA Golden Ticket Pickleball Tournament will be held at the Plaza Hotel and Casino next month (Credit: USA Golden Ticket Pickleball) “With the most pickleball courts of any resort, the Plaza has become the ultimate destination for pickleball in Las Vegas,” added Jonathan Jossel, CEO of the Plaza Hotel & Casino. “We’re excited to host this prestigious tournament and welcome top USA Pickleball players from across the nation. Expect thrilling matches and stunning views of the Las Vegas valley—this is one event you won’t want to miss!”
The tournament will take place Feb. 18-22 at the Plaza Hotel and Casino.
